title: 第1504章 震众人三等战皇第1503章 战虎圣遭到轻视
content_zh:
他大步上前，直接挡在林玄面前。
“小家伙，你叫什么名字？哪个军团的？区区紫金统领就敢独自来宝器塔，胆子不小啊。”
林玄停下脚步，神色平淡地看向眼前这尊虎妖。
青雨圣微微蹙眉，轻声开口：“战虎，别吓着人家。”
她目光落在林玄身上，仔细打量片刻。
“这位统领，应该不是普通的紫金统领。”
战虎圣嗤笑一声：“不是普通紫金统领？难不成还是四星紫金统领？”
“四星紫金统领那也是统领，连皇者门槛都没摸到。”
他凑近林玄，咧嘴露出森白獠牙。
“小家伙，宝器塔里的东西可不便宜，你有军功吗？”
林玄没有理会他，径直绕过战虎圣，朝宝器塔入口走去。
战虎圣一愣，随即嘿笑一声。
“有意思，这小家伙还挺傲。”
青雨圣望着林玄背影，若有所思。
“战虎，你有没有感觉，这人身上的杀气很重。”
战虎圣不以为然地摆摆手：“能从玄武废墟活着回来的，哪个身上没有杀气？”
“行了，咱俩也跟进去看看，我倒是好奇这小家伙能买得起什么。”
林玄踏入宝器塔一层。
眼前豁然开朗。
塔内空间远比外面看起来大得多，足有千丈方圆。

一排排水晶柜整齐排列，柜中陈列着各式各样的铠甲、兵器、丹药、秘术玉简。
每一件都散发着强大的灵能波动。
最低也是顶尖圣器级别。
数十名修士在柜前挑选宝物，十几名身着宝器塔制式衣袍的侍者穿梭其间。
林玄没有浪费时间，直接走向铠甲区域。
他目光扫过一个个水晶柜。
紫炎甲，低等圣级，三百八十万灵晶。
天罡战铠，低等圣级，四百万灵晶。
玄武重甲，低等圣级，四百二十万灵晶。
林玄在一件泛着紫金色光芒的铠甲前停下脚步。
这件铠甲通体呈暗紫色，表面有金色纹路流转，胸口位置镶嵌着一枚拳头大小的灵能核心，散发着浑厚沉稳的气息。
紫金浑天铠。
低等圣级。
售价：四百五十万灵晶，或一枚一星黑暗统领徽章。
林玄伸手敲了敲水晶柜。
一名女性侍者立刻上前，面带微笑：“统领大人，您看中这件紫金浑天铠了？”
“这件铠甲防御力在低等圣级中属于顶尖，可抵御一星将军级别的全力一击。”
“而且内嵌了自愈阵法，即使受损也能缓慢修复。”
林玄点头。
这是给秦有容准备的。

有容修为尚浅，这件铠甲正好适合她。
他翻手取出一枚一星黑暗统领徽章，递给侍者。
“就这件。”
content_en:
He strode forward and stood directly in front of Lin Xuan.
"Little guy, what's your name? Which legion do you belong to? Commander Zijin dares to come to the Treasure Tower alone. He's very courageous."
Lin Xuan stopped and looked at the tiger monster in front of him with a calm expression.
Qingyu Sheng frowned slightly and said softly: "Zhan Hu, don't scare others."
Her eyes fell on Lin Xuan and she looked at him carefully for a moment.
"This commander should not be an ordinary purple and gold commander."
Zhan Tiger Saint sneered: "Not an ordinary purple gold commander? Could it be that he is still a four-star purple gold commander?"
"The four-star purple-gold commander is also a commander. He has not even touched the threshold of the emperor."
He leaned closer to Lin Xuan, grinning and revealing his white fangs.
"Little guy, the things in the Treasure Tower are not cheap. Do you have military merit?"
Lin Xuan ignored him and walked directly around the Tiger Saint and towards the entrance of the treasure tower.
Zhan Husheng was stunned for a moment, then chuckled.
"Interesting, this little guy is quite proud."
Qingyu Sheng looked at Lin Xuan's back, thoughtfully.
"Zhan Hu, do you feel that this man has a strong murderous aura?"
Zhan Husheng waved his hand disapprovingly: "Who can come back alive from the Xuanwu ruins without murderous intent?"
"Okay, let's go and have a look. I'm curious about what this little guy can afford."
Lin Xuan stepped into the first floor of the treasure tower.
My eyes suddenly opened up.
The space inside the tower is much larger than it looks from the outside, measuring thousands of feet in diameter.
Rows of crystal cabinets are neatly arranged, displaying a variety of armors, weapons, elixirs, and jade slips of secret techniques.
Each piece exudes powerful psychic energy fluctuations.
The lowest level is also the top holy weapon level.
Dozens of monks were selecting treasures in front of the cabinet, and more than a dozen waiters in treasure tower-style robes shuttled between them.
Lin Xuan wasted no time and walked directly to the armor area.
He glanced at the crystal cabinets.
Purple Flame Armor, low-level saint level, 3.8 million spiritual crystals.
Tiangang battle armor, low-level holy level, four million spiritual crystals.
Xuanwu heavy armor, low holy level, 4.2 million spiritual crystals.
Lin Xuan stopped in front of a piece of armor glowing with purple-gold light.
This armor is dark purple in color, with golden lines flowing on the surface. There is a fist-sized psychic core inlaid on the chest, exuding a rich and steady aura.
Purple gold muddy sky armor.
Low holy level.
Price: 4.5 million spiritual crystals, or a one-star dark leadership badge.
Lin Xuan reached out and knocked on the crystal cabinet.
A female waiter immediately stepped forward with a smile on her face: "Lord Commander, do you like this purple and gold Huntian Armor?"
"The defensive power of this armor is among the best among low-level saints. It can withstand a full blow from a one-star general."
"And it has a self-healing array built in, so even if it is damaged, it can be repaired slowly."
Lin Xuan nodded.
This was prepared for Qin Yourong.
Yourong's cultivation is still shallow, so this armor suits her just right.
He turned over his hand and took out a one-star dark leadership badge and handed it to the waiter.
"That's it."
